races.display_title: Betway British EBF Rosemary Stakes (Fillies' And Mares' Listed)
races.verdict: A final chance is given to ARISAIG , who hasn't won since summer 2024 but Charlie Johnston's mare is clearly capable of winning races at this level provided things drop right. Alobayyah was progressive prior to her Haydock blip last month, so she's put forward as the main danger, while Estissa and Gilding The Lily are a couple of progressive 3-y-os who may also be involved at the business end, too. ARISAIG ALOBAYYAH ESTISSA

races.display_title: Princess Royal Stakes (Sponsored By Betway) (Fillies' And Mares' Group 3)
races.verdict: INIS MOR presumably failed to cope with soft ground in the Yorkshire Oaks and a return to the form she showed when placed in the French/Irish Oaks prior to that will make her tough to beat. Prizeland and Coedana are next best on form, while the unbeaten Without Prejudice looks capable of making an impact in this higher grade. INIS MOR (FR) PRIZELAND COEDANA (IRE)

races.display_title: Betway Rockfel Stakes (Fillies' Group 2)
races.verdict: SPIRITED GESTURE could hardly have created a better impression on her 2 starts to date and given her pedigree and connections, she's fancied to take the step up to Group 2 company in her stride. Light of Dawn and Sugar Yes Please are already pattern-race winners and they are just a couple of potential threats. SPIRITED GESTURE LIGHT OF DAWN SUGAR YES PLEASE

races.verdict: TALK OF NEW YORK has developed into a smart performer this year, beaten only 1¾ lengths by Bow Echo in the St James's Palace at Royal Ascot, and he is well worth another chance having had excuses at Goodwood last time. races.verdict: Preference is for ROAD TO WEMBLEY , who overcame a troubled passage when scoring here last month and appeals as the type to progress further in handicap company. Course winner Down To Business has likely been aimed at this contest by his shrewd handler and is feared most, whilst Devon Red and Lock Stock are also of interest in what looks a competitive heat. races.verdict: RUGBY UNION did well under the circumstances having had his run blocked more than once when scoring over C&D 23 days ago and a 3 lb rise for that breakthrough success ought to see him very competitive again. Balmoral Boy arrives on the back of a good third at Redcar and is feared up in trip, with Token Love another fancied to be in the shake-up. RUGBY UNION (USA) BALMORAL BOY (IRE) TOKEN LOVE (FR)

races.display_title: MWH Treatment Handicap
races.verdict: BAJAN BANDIT bounced back from a rare poor effort to win over C&D 6 days ago and looks well capable of following up given he escapes a penalty for that success. Four-time C&D winner Barleybrown chased the selection home that day and could face the same scenario here, while, Volenti is well weighted if able to race more efficiently. BAJAN BANDIT BARLEYBROWN VOLENTI (IRE)

races.display_title: Northumbrian WaterAid Sprint Handicap
races.verdict: LORD ABAMA went close to cashing in on his much-reduced mark over C&D last week and a reproduction of that effort may well suffice. Ridgemaster and Desert Master arrive in good nick and head the opposition. LORD ABAMA (IRE) RIDGEMASTER (IRE) DESERT MASTER

races.display_title: Friday Night Lights At Dundalk Claiming Maiden
races.verdict: A wide-open claiming maiden in which preference is for WILLOFTHEPEOPLE , who probably needed the run in a first-time tongue strap after 11 months off when fifth at Bellewstown recently and Ger Lyons' 3-y-o drops back down to a sprint trip. The return to 6f should suit In The Gloaming , so he's put forward as the main threat on all-weather debut, with Aughlish and Saint Acclaim taken to fight out third. WILLOFTHEPEOPLE (IRE) IN THE GLOAMING (IRE) AUGHLISH (IRE)
races.betting_forecast: In The Gloaming (7/2), Aughlish (9/2), Willofthepeople (5/1), Hallelujah Rose (11/2), All Hail (6/1), Beach Barbie (7/1), White Smoke (8/1), Optics (12/1), Raven's Call (12/1), Saint Acclaim (12/1), Sarfarcat (16/1), Cleopatra Dream (20/1), Betsy Trotwood (20/1), Tudor Flame (25/1), San Giulio (33/1), Whatsin The Stars (33/1), Anaverna (66/1)

races.verdict: The addition of Colin Keane could be the catalyst for VERVAIN to double her career tally. The dangers are headed by 3-y-o pair Connecteo and Connova . In-form pair Deluca Chop and Bhean Saibhre are also respected, while My Vonnie is one to consider at bigger prices in a competitive big-field handicap. VERVAIN (IRE) CONNECTEO (IRE) CONNOVA (IRE)

races.verdict: A useful stayer on the Flat for Willie Mullins, REACHING HIGH should be able to make it second time lucky over hurdles. REACHING HIGH (IRE) LADBROKE GROVE (FR) CONFIDENCE WITHIN (IRE)

races.verdict: WHO'S DA GOOSE made a successful handicap debut at Wexford last month and with the scope to rate higher, he can follow-up for last year's winning jockey and trainer partnership. Tell Me See and Freddie Robdal head the opposition. WHO'S DA GOOSE TELL ME SEE (IRE) FREDDIE ROBDAL (IRE)

races.verdict: VIVA LAA VIDA showed promise in a bumper that's worked out well at Down Royal in March and is fancied to strike at the second time of asking for a yard going well with its runners in this discipline. Shuil Solas is worth another chance to build on a promising debut having shaped as if amiss at Wexford last time, while Orbital Ocean is an appealing newcomer to monitor closely in the betting. VIVA LAA VIDA (IRE) SHUIL SOLAS (IRE) ORBITAL OCEAN (IRE)

races.verdict: DAVY CROCKETT didn't go on as expected over hurdles (also fell sole chase start) but got his career back on track with the help of the stewards when making a successful debut in this sphere at Tramore 6 weeks ago. Promising to be suited by this longer trip and open to improvement, he edges preference over Joseph O'Brien's Delta , who is more than capable but has become frustrating. Sunny South West and Quinta Do Lago complete the shortlist. DAVY CROCKETT (IRE) DELTA SUNNY SOUTH WEST (IRE)
